verdict.rationale: Abacum documents budgets alongside live actuals in one model, normalized charts of accounts, and drill-down to source data on consolidated statements, so the building parts of budget-vs-actuals exist as its own capability. There is no explicit evidence of a variance report sliced by department and account, or of drilling from a specific variance into its transactions. Missing for 10: explicit budget-vs-actuals variance reporting, department-level slicing, transaction-level drill-down from a variance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, budget-vs-actuals runs by department and account, with drill-down into the transactions behind a variance
